source.author: lucan
source.text: Saepe Noto plenae, tensisque rudentibus actae Ipsa maris per claustra rates fastigia molis Discussere salo, spatiumque dedere carinis: Tortaque per tenebras validis ballista lacertis, Multifidas iaculata faces.
source.text_original: Saepe Noto plenae, tensisque rudentibus actae / Ipsa maris per claustra rates fastigia molis / Discussere salo, spatiumque dedere carinis: / Tortaque per tenebras validis ballista lacertis, / Multifidas iaculata faces.
source.text_english: Often, when filled by the south wind and driven with tightened ropes, the ships themselves through the sea’s barriers shattered the summit of the mole and gave space for the keels: and a ballista, twisted through the darkness with strong arms, flung many-forked firebrands.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: pateant montes silvaeque lacusque cunctaque claustra maris; spes et metus omnibus esto.
reuse.text_original: pateant montes silvaeque lacusque / cunctaque claustra maris; spes et metus omnibus esto.
reuse.text_english: Let the mountains and forests and lakes and all the barriers of the sea be laid open; let hope and fear be for all.
